11: # Extrema of the Lagrangian density
12: 
13: ## i. Overview
14: 
15: In this module we define what it means for an electromagnetic potential
16: to be an extremum of the Lagrangian density in presence of a Lorentz current density.
17: 
18: This is equivalent to the electromagnetic potential satisfying
19: Maxwell's equations with sources, i.e. Gauss's law and Ampère's law.
20: 
21: ## ii. Key results
22: 
23: - `IsExtrema` : The condition on an electromagnetic potential to be an extrema of the lagrangian.
24: - `isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix` : The electromagnetic potential is an extrema
25:   of the lagrangian if and only if Gauss's law and Ampère's law hold
26:   (in terms of the magnetic field matrix).
27: - `time_deriv_time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix_of_isExtrema` : A wave-like equation for the
28:   magnetic field matrix from the extrema condition.
29: - `time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema` : A wave-like equation for the
30:   electric field from the extrema condition.
31:

35:   - A.1. Extrema condition in terms of the field strength matrix

38: - B. Gauss's law and Ampère's law and the extrema condition

40: - D. Second time derivatives from the extrema condition
41:   - D.1. Second time derivatives of the magnetic field from the extrema condition
42:   - D.2. Second time derivatives of the electric field from the extrema condition

69: ## A. The condition for an extrema of the Lagrangian density
70: 
71: -/
72: 
73: /-- The condition on an electromagnetic potential to be an extrema of the lagrangian. -/
74: def IsExtrema {d} (𝓕 : FreeSpace) (A : ElectromagneticPotential d)
75:     (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d) : Prop :=
76:   gradLagrangian 𝓕 A J = 0
77: 
78: lemma isExtrema_iff_gradLagrangian {𝓕 : FreeSpace} (A : ElectromagneticPotential d)
79:     (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d) :
80:     IsExtrema 𝓕 A J ↔ A.gradLagrangian 𝓕 J = 0 := by rfl
81: 
82: /-!
83: 
84: ### A.1. Extrema condition in terms of the field strength matrix
85: 
86: -/
87: 
88: lemma isExtrema_iff_fieldStrengthMatrix {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
89:     (A : ElectromagneticPotential d)
90:     (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d) (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) :
91:     IsExtrema 𝓕 A J ↔
92:     ∀ x, ∀ ν, ∑ μ, ∂_ μ (A.fieldStrengthMatrix · (μ, ν)) x = 𝓕.μ₀ * J x ν := by
93:   rw [isExtrema_iff_gradLagrangian, gradLagrangian_eq_sum_fieldStrengthMatrix A hA J hJ, funext_iff]
94:   conv_lhs =>
95:     enter [x, 1, 2, ν]
96:     rw [smul_smul]
97:   conv_lhs =>
98:     enter [x]
99:     simp only [one_div, Pi.zero_apply]
100:     rw [Lorentz.Vector.sum_basis_eq_zero_iff]
101:   apply Iff.intro
102:   · intro h x ν
103:     specialize h x ν
104:     simp at h
105:     have h' : η ν ν ≠ 0 := η_diag_ne_zero
106:     simp_all
107:     linear_combination (norm := field_simp) 𝓕.μ₀ * h
108:     ring
109:   · intro h x ν
110:     specialize h x ν
111:     simp only [mul_eq_zero]
112:     right
113:     linear_combination (norm := field_simp) 𝓕.μ₀⁻¹ * h
114:     ring
115: 
116: /-!

300: ### D.1. Second time derivatives of the magnetic field from the extrema condition
301: 
302: We show that the magnetic field matrix $B_{ij}$ satisfies the following wave-like equation
303: 
304: $$\frac{\partial^2 B_{ij}}{\partial t^2} = c^2 \sum_k \frac{\partial^2 B_{ij}}{\partial x_k^2} +
305:   \frac{1}{\epsilon_0} \left(\frac{\partial J_i}{\partial x_j} -
306:   \frac{\partial J_j}{\partial x_i} \right).$$
307: When the free current density is zero, this reduces to the wave equation.
308: -/
309: 
310: lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
311:     {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
312:     (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
313:     (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
314:     (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i j : Fin d) :
315:     ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · x (i, j))) t =
316:     𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ k, ∂[k] (∂[k] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (i, j))) x +
317:     𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ * (∂[j] (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c t · i) x - ∂[i] (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c t · j) x) := by
318:   have hcd : ∀ ij, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t y ij) :=
319:     fun ij => magneticFieldMatrix_space_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t ij
320:   have hsd : ∀ ij k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t y ij)) :=
321:     fun ij k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hcd ij) k
322:   have hJd : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (fun x => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c t x i) :=
323:     fun i => LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_space
324:       (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) t i
325:   rw [time_deriv_time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out))]
326:   conv_lhs =>
327:     enter [2, 2, x]
328:     rw [time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
329:   conv_lhs =>
330:     enter [1, 2, x]
331:     rw [time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
332:   rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
333:   rw [fderiv_fun_sub ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun i _ => hsd _ i).const_mul _).differentiableAt
334:       ((hJd _).const_mul _).differentiableAt,
335:     fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun i _ => hsd _ i).differentiableAt,
336:     fderiv_const_mul (hJd _).differentiableAt,
337:     fderiv_fun_sum fun i _ => (hsd _ i).differentiableAt]
338:   conv_lhs =>
339:     enter [2]
340:     rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
341:     rw [fderiv_fun_sub ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun i _ => hsd _ i).const_mul _).differentiableAt
342:         ((hJd _).const_mul _).differentiableAt,
343:     fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun i _ => hsd _ i).differentiableAt,
344:     fderiv_const_mul (hJd _).differentiableAt,
345:     fderiv_fun_sum fun i _ => (hsd _ i).differentiableAt]
346:   simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, FreeSpace.c_sq]
347:   field_simp
348:   conv_rhs =>
349:     enter [1, 2, k, 2, x]
350:     rw [magneticFieldMatrix_space_deriv_eq A (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl))]
351:   conv_rhs =>
352:     enter [1, 2, k]
353:     rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
354:     rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hsd _ _).differentiableAt (hsd _ _).differentiableAt]
355:     simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
356:     rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hcd _)]
357:     enter [2]
358:     rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hcd _)]
359:   simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
360:   ring

364: ### D.2. Second time derivatives of the electric field from the extrema condition
365: 
366: We show that the electric field $E_i$ satisfies the following wave-like equation:
367: 
368: $$\frac{\partial^2 E_{i}}{\partial t^2} = c^2 \sum_k \frac{\partial^2 E_{i}}{\partial x_k^2} -
369:   \frac{c ^ 2}{\epsilon_0} \frac{\partial \rho}{\partial x_i} -
370:   c ^ 2 μ_0 \frac{\partial J_i}{\partial t}.$$
371: 
372: When the free current density and charge density are zero, this reduces to the wave equation.
373: 
374: -/
375: 
376: lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
377:     {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
378:     (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
379:     (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
380:     (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
381:     ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
382:       𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
383:       𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
384:       𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
385:   have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
386:     fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
387:   have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j)) :=
388:     fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
389:   have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
390:       (fun s => ∂[j] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
391:     fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
392:       (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
393:   have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
394:     LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) x i
395:   calc _
396:     _= ∂ₜ (fun t =>
397:       1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, Space.deriv j (fun x => magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c A t x (j, i)) x -
398:       1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity 𝓕.c J t x i) t := by
399:         conv_lhs =>
400:           enter [1]
401:           change fun t => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) t
402:           enter [t]
403:           rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
404:             (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
405:             time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
406:     _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∂ₜ (fun t => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x) t -
407:       1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
408:       rw [Time.deriv_eq]
409:       rw [fderiv_fun_sub]
410:       simp only [one_div, mul_inv_rev, FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply]
411:       rw [fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt]
412:       rw [fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]
413:       simp [Time.deriv_eq]
414:       · exact ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
415:       · exact hJt.differentiableAt.const_mul _
416:     _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ((∑ j, ∂ₜ (fun t => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x)) t) -
417:       1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * (∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t) := by
418:       congr
419:       rw [Time.deriv_eq]
420:       rw [fderiv_fun_sum fun i _ => (hBt i).differentiableAt]
421:       simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
422:       rfl
423:     _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∑ j, ∂[j] (fun x => ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · x (j, i)) t)) x -
424:         1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
425:       congr
426:       simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
427:       congr

433:         ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x)) x -
434:         1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
